messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up
We need a terse traffic-light for the GA cut tomorrow. Minimal gate list I distilled: SLA doc, pricing table + FAQ, billing smoke, runbooks, monitoring alerts, oncall rota. Who takes what? :eyes:
Devon: I got SLA doc + oncall rota. Will upload draft PR by EOD PDT.
Matt: Pricing table + billing smoke here. Ill run a synthetic tenant invoice test.
Sophia: Monitoring alerts + runbooks. Proposing three primary signals: p95 latency, token-cost variance, error rate.
Lydia: ops-bot will handle the scheduled smoke jobs once Matt flips the flags. Ill audit runbook steps for partial fallback.
Matt: Added new dedicated tier bits in pricing/config.yaml. Snippet:
```
tiers:\n  - name: reserved\n    commit_months: 12\n    discount_pct: 30\n```
Matt: Billing smoke plan: spawn tenant x-smoke, fire 1k generation requests, assert invoice event emitted and rounding matches expected.
Devon: SLA draft at https://docs.internal/sla/dedicated-ga 
Key SLOs: uptime 99.9%, p50 200ms, p95 750ms. Escalation ladder included.
Sophia: Alert thresholds suggestion: p95 > 900ms (P0), error_rate > 0.5% (P0), queue_len > 50 (P1). Also enable 1% trace sampling during first 24h burn-in.
Anya: Two ops items: (1) confirm runbook includes fallback to smaller model variant with explicit commands; (2) confirm billing cost-override knob for pilots.
Lydia: Runbook PR #412 contains fallback flow and `curl` snippets for rollback. Example:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.redwood/api/v1/rollout -d '{"strategy":"fallback-small"}'
```
Lydia: Ill append a one-line oncall checklist to the runbook.
Matt: We already have `pilot_override` in billing service. Will add docs link from pricing table.
Devon: ops-bot please schedule billing smoke at 04:45 UTC and post result here.
ops-bot: scheduled smoke job `billing-smoke-176432` for 2025-04-10T04:45:00Z. Will report pass/fail.
Sophia: Docs note: SDK streaming example needs small tweak to show graceful fallback handling. Ill send a micro-PR.
Anya: Owners recap: Devon -> SLA + oncall rota, Matt -> pricing + billing smoke + FAQ, Sophia -> monitoring + runbook + SDK snippet, Lydia -> runbook checklist + fallback verification. Ill own release checklist and the legal/commercial ping.
Devon: PR ETA 17:00 PT.
Matt: Local smoke run scheduled 03:30 UTC, will post before ops-bot run.
ops-bot: billing-smoke-176432 completed: PASS. invoice_event_count=1 expected=1. cost_delta=0.0. logs: https://logs.redwood/smoke/176432
Anya: Great. Commercial asked for a short pilot FAQ (refunds/overages) 
Please add to pricing doc.
Matt: Drafting FAQ now, will push to pricing doc.
Lydia: Runbook checklist merged, oncall rota updated.
Anya: Green if all PRs merged by 17:00 PT. If anything slips mark amber and escalate to shiproom. :shipit:
Sophia: Acknowledge. Ill watch alerts during burn-in and bump if thresholds need tuning.
Devon: Will merge SLA PR once reviews land.
Anya: Thanks team 
Final status posted to #all-hands at 17:15 PT.
